environment: Disposable restored local database with migrations 127-134 and source-equivalent application ACL on the clone. Actual candidate Next page/API and one synthetic paused run containing forty synthetic tool receipts. No task worker was started; clone dropped after verification.

results.api: The run list returned the exact synthetic run and the event SSE API returned all forty stored tool-result receipts.
results.actualPage: At 390x760 and 1366x900, the run card initially showed the latest sixteen events. Loading earlier records exposed all forty and the first event. The second viewport saw forty-one events because the first viewport's actual control request had added one persistent control receipt.
results.instruction: Each viewport submitted a unique synthetic follow-up through the real control API (HTTP 200), cleared its unchanged draft after success, and the two instruction values were read back from the database. On desktop, the fixture changed the run to completed immediately before a third request; the actual control API returned 409, and the page retained that rejected instruction and displayed its operation error.

limits: The failed-control case uses a synthetic concurrent status change on a disposable clone, not a natural task transition. No live running task was exercised. Production loading, real task history and other G13 entries still require separate evidence.
